en.title: LIVE TICKER - Iran War: Houthi Militia and Saudi Arabia Report Further Attacks
en.summary: The United States and Iran have been in a state of war since February 2026. Although they agreed to a ceasefire, Donald Trump declared it ended in early July. The ticker covers the latest developments.

stories.title: Les femmes gagnent toujours moins que les hommes en Suisse

en.title: Women Still Earn Less Than Men in Switzerland
en.summary: Young women in Switzerland continue to earn less than young men despite higher education levels. The income gap has narrowed significantly over time, standing at 14 percent for those born in 1995.

stories.title: Le triple A de la Ville de Zurich menacé par l'augmentation de la dette

en.title: Zurich's Triple A Rating Threatened by Rising Debt
en.summary: Zurich faces potential loss of its triple A credit rating, the best possible financial grade. Standard & Poor's downgraded the outlook from stable to negative due to rapidly increasing debt projected to reach 14 billion francs by 2030.

en.summary: A new reference work aims to help decode far-right codes and potentially discriminatory symbols that can appear in emoji communications.

en.title: Actor RJ Mitte, known from 'Breaking Bad,' has died
en.summary: RJ Mitte, the actor who played Walter White's son in Breaking Bad and was an advocate for people with disabilities, died at age 34. His agent did not specify the cause of death.

en.title: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford receive the Nobel Prize in Economics
en.summary: Two researchers received the economics Nobel Prize for their work demonstrating how central banks and finance ministries can better mitigate the effects of economic shocks such as oil crises, wars, and inflation.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Navi Pillay hat den Friedensnobelpreis erhalten. Dabei ist ihre Bilanz bei Frieden und für Menschenrechte düster

en.title: COMMENTARY - Navi Pillay received the Nobel Peace Prize. Yet her record on peace and human rights is bleak
en.summary: The former UN human rights commissioner received the Nobel Peace Prize despite a record where serious crimes went unpunished during her tenure. Critics note she investigated Israeli human rights violations while having previously signed a statement supporting the BDS movement.

en.title: The province of Alberta is flirting with separation from Canada
